acceptance_criteria.description: Users must not be able to access any page without first logging in with valid credentials.
kane_steps: Navigate directly to https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html without logging in
Observe that the user is redirected back to the login page
Confirm no inventory content is displayed
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Protected pages require valid login first

acceptance_criteria.description: After submitting valid credentials, the user is redirected to the product inventory page.
kane_steps: Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/
Enter username 'standard_user' and password 'secret_sauce'
Click the Login button
Confirm the user lands on the inventory page (URL contains /inventory.html)
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Successful login redirects to inventory page

acceptance_criteria.description: The inventory page displays product tiles each containing a product name, image, and price.
kane_steps: Log in with valid credentials
Navigate to the inventory page
Verify each product tile shows a product name, an image, and a price
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Inventory tiles show name, image, and price

acceptance_criteria.description: Clicking a product name on the inventory page opens that product's detail page.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click on any product name link
Confirm the product detail page is displayed for the selected product
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Clicking product name opens detail page

acceptance_criteria.description: Clicking a product image on the inventory page opens that product's detail page.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click on any product image
Confirm the product detail page is displayed for the selected product
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Clicking product image opens detail page

acceptance_criteria.description: The product detail page displays the product name, description, price, and an Add to cart button.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click on a product to open its detail page
Verify the page shows the product name, a description, a price, and an 'Add to cart' button
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Detail page shows name, description, price, button

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can add a product to the cart from the inventory page by clicking the Add to cart button.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click the 'Add to cart' button on any product tile
Confirm the product is added to the cart (cart badge updates)
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Add to cart button adds product from inventory

acceptance_criteria.description: After clicking Add to cart on the inventory page, the button label changes to 'Remove'.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click the 'Add to cart' button on a product tile
Confirm the button label for that product now reads 'Remove'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Add to cart button changes to Remove

acceptance_criteria.description: The cart badge in the top navigation updates to reflect the current number of items in the cart.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Add one product to the cart
Verify the cart badge shows '1'
Add another product and verify the badge updates to '2'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Cart badge count updates on item addition

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can remove a product from the inventory page by clicking the Remove button.
kane_steps: Log in, navigate to the inventory page, and add a product to the cart
Click the 'Remove' button on that product tile
Confirm the cart badge count decreases accordingly
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Remove button removes product from inventory page

acceptance_criteria.description: After clicking Remove on the inventory page, the button label changes back to 'Add to cart'.
kane_steps: Log in, add a product to the cart from the inventory page
Click the 'Remove' button on that product tile
Confirm the button label reverts to 'Add to cart'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Remove button reverts to Add to cart label

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can navigate to the cart page at /cart.html.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click the cart icon in the top navigation
Confirm the URL changes to contain /cart.html and the cart page is displayed
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Cart icon navigates to cart page

acceptance_criteria.description: The cart page lists all previously added items, each showing its name, quantity, and price.
kane_steps: Log in and add two or more products to the cart from the inventory page
Navigate to the cart page (/cart.html)
Verify each added item is listed with its name, quantity, and price
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Cart page lists items with name, quantity, price

acceptance_criteria.description: A sort dropdown is visible and usable in the top right of the inventory page.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Locate the sort dropdown in the top right area
Click the dropdown and confirm it opens with sorting options
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Sort dropdown is present on inventory page

acceptance_criteria.description: The sort dropdown provides exactly four options: Name (A to Z), Name (Z to A), Price (low to high), and Price (high to low).
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click the sort dropdown
Verify the available options are 'Name (A to Z)', 'Name (Z to A)', 'Price (low to high)', and 'Price (high to low)'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Sort dropdown has four correct options

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting 'Price (low to high)' sorts products so the cheapest item (Sauce Labs Onesie at $7.99) appears first.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Select 'Price (low to high)' from the sort dropdown
Verify the first product displayed is 'Sauce Labs Onesie' priced at $7.99
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Price low to high sorts cheapest item first

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting 'Name (A to Z)' sorts products alphabetically so Sauce Labs Backpack appears first.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Select 'Name (A to Z)' from the sort dropdown
Verify the first product displayed is 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Name A to Z sorts Backpack first
